name: Implement Stdlib `conforms` Function and Per-Trait Helpers

task_definition.title: Implement Stdlib `conforms` Function and Per-Trait Helpers
task_definition.description: Implement three monomorphic stdlib helper functions for geometry traits: `is_watertight`, `is_manifold`, and `is_orientable`. These functions will dispatch to kernel queries and return a boolean indicating trait conformance.
